title: Audio comparison pairing
responsibility: Finds unambiguous before-and-after audio pairs in recorded evidence.

inputs.name: audioPairs.items
inputs.description: Evidence items; only audio with a nonblank comparison name and before/after phase participate.

outputs.name: audioPairs
outputs.description: Map from each after-item identifier to its before item, grouped by exact comparison text and viewport. Only groups with exactly one item on each side are paired; ambiguous and incomplete groups are omitted.
